name: product-demo-satellite
summary: Reconciles the local Satellite Product Demo scenario in AAP.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses APD resources, overlays owned playbooks in the retained bootstrap project, and reconciles only managed templates and credentials.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: If local playbook staging fails, the addon stops before changing Satellite credentials.

readiness: AAP controller API is reachable and authenticated.
The APD bootstrap project has a retained task-pod checkout.
A unique RHEL9 or RHEL10 Satellite content profile is published.
Satellite setup completes with managed credentials before Fleet registration or inventory synchronization.

security.secret_storage: SATELLITE_PASSWORD is read from the encrypted credential Vault when it is not explicitly supplied for the process.
security.network_trust: AAP and Satellite connections retain certificate validation; CA content is configured explicitly when required.
security.external_actions: The addon changes only owned AAP resources and the local Satellite lab; it does not open vendor tickets or send external email.
